user.title: NeonPlan 3D
user.description: Adds a sidebar page where you draw your home and see it in 3D.

ask.name: Ask the house
ask.description: Hands a sentence to the open NeonPlan 3D views: "Show the living room" shows it, questions are answered by the installed modules ("What is open?"). The first view that understands answers.

text.name: Sentence
text.description: What to show or ask, as you would say it.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: Only the view with this screen name reacts (set in the view's settings or the card's option screen). Empty: every open view.

speak.name: Speak
speak.description: The view speaks its answer with Assist's text-to-speech (off: it only shows it).

announce.name: Announcement
announce.description: Says a message on the speakers of the plan's rooms, as the Announcements module does (needs the module). Each room uses its chosen speaker, else one placed in it, else one of its area, else the default speaker from the module's settings.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names in the plan (or their Home Assistant areas). Empty: every room (of the floor, when one is given).

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Only the rooms of this floor (its name in the plan).

ignore_quiet.name: Ignore quiet time
ignore_quiet.description: Speak in rooms that have their quiet time now, too. A single room asked for by name always speaks.

on_screens.name: On NeonPlan screens
on_screens.description: Every open NeonPlan screen (a wall tablet too) speaks the message itself and shows it. Without rooms or a floor only the screens speak.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: Only the NeonPlan screens with these screen names (set in the view's settings or the card's option screen).

spaceview_announce.name: Space View announcement
spaceview_announce.description: Says a message on available speakers in the plan or on selected open Space View screens. Uses the approved Announcements module when installed; otherwise Space View finds media players placed in each room or assigned to its Home Assistant area, with Home Assistant TTS as a fallback.

message.name: Message
message.description: What the speakers and selected screens announce.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names in the plan, aliases, ids, or linked Home Assistant area names. Empty: every eligible room (of the floor, when one is given).

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Only the rooms and outdoor areas of this floor.

on_screens.name: On Space View screens
on_screens.description: Show and speak the message on open Space View screens. Without rooms or a floor, only screens speak.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: Only Space View screens with these screen names.
